note: Hasselt town wall (13th c., four gates; rebuilt several times, replaced by an earthen rampart only in 1705), traced from the Ferraris map (1777), whose wall line follows the medieval one. Wet moat all round. Local metres around the Grote Markt (x east, z south).
source: Inventaris Onroerend Erfgoed, 'Historische stadskern van Hasselt' (https://id.erfgoed.net/erfgoedobjecten/140049)
